[b]我喜欢这种尖顶和落地窗的设计，太天才了。但我使用FreeLove，改装后的农舍会影响伴侣的婚后行程。所以我做了这个。
[/b]I love the spire and floor to ceiling windows, it's genius. But I use FreeLove and a converted farmhouse would interfere with my partner's post-wedding itinerary. So I made this one.

[b]只修改了餐厅和角落房间。需要升级两次农舍，去找罗宾装修添加。[/b]
Only the dining room and corner room have been modified. Need to upgrade the farmhouse twice, go to Robin for renovation additions.

[b]因为只对小区域进行了修改，所以应该兼容RRRR。不兼容其他农舍修改。基于1.6版本进行构建，所以不兼容1.5版本，很抱歉。[/b]
It should be compatible with RRRR since only small areas have been modified. Not compatible with other farmhouse changes. Building based on version 1.6, so not compatible with version 1.5, sorry about that.

[b]我简单的测试过，没发现问题。如果季节改变后的第一天窗户没有变化，只要走出房门再回去就正常了。除此之外，有任何bug请向我报告。[/b]
I tested it briefly and didn't find a problem. If the windows don't change on the first day after the season change, just walk out of the room and back in and it's normal. Other than that, please report any bugs to me.[/left]
